summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 earnings release (US equivalent of an 8-K earnings exhibit). Total operating revenues were US$1.17 billion, down about 10% from US$1.31 billion a year earlier; operating income fell to US$100.2 million from US$184.5 million, and Adjusted Property EBITDA declined to US$287.6 million from US$380.4 million. Net income attributable to the company was US$34 thousand, or US$0.00009 per ADS. City of Dreams revenue was US$566.2 million with Adjusted EBITDA of US$130.3 million. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; risk-arb angle is not applicable.
